Privacy by Design Architecture

We believe utility applications should never spy on users. Here is how we guarantee your privacy.

🔒

100% Local LAN Communication

All remote control commands (Volume, Navigation, Power, Channel switching) travel strictly over your local Wi-Fi router directly to your TV's local IP address or via your phone's built-in Infrared blaster. Nothing passes through intermediate cloud servers.

👤

No Accounts, No Profiles

You do not need to register, sign up, or link any social media profile to use this application. We never request your name, phone number, email address, or home location. The app launches immediately ready to control your TV.

🛡️

Zero Cloud Analytics Tracking

We do not track which TV channels you watch, what videos you cast, what apps you launch, or how frequently you turn on your TV. What you watch and do in your living room remains exclusively your private business.

Transparent Permissions Breakdown

Every permission requested by Universal TV Remote Control serves a strictly technical, user-visible function.

Android Permission Technical Purpose Privacy Status
android.permission.INTERNET Sends direct control keystrokes (REST / WebSockets) to Smart TVs on the local Wi-Fi subnet. ✓ Local LAN Only
ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
ACCESS_WIFI_STATE		 Checks whether your phone is connected to Wi-Fi so it can discover and connect to your TV. ✓ Read-Only Status
CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE Enables SSDP (Simple Service Discovery Protocol) and mDNS to automatically detect nearby TVs. ✓ Device Discovery Only
android.permission.TRANSMIT_IR Transmits infrared control frequencies to legacy TVs on phones equipped with an IR hardware blaster. ✓ Hardware Sensor Only
android.permission.VIBRATE Provides subtle tactile haptic vibration feedback whenever you tap a button on the remote. ✓ UI Haptics Only

Official Privacy Policy & Terms

Last Updated: November 18, 2026 • Effective Immediately

1. Introduction & Commitment

This Privacy Policy governs the Universal TV Remote Control mobile application ("the App"), developed by Said Doublal ("the Developer"). We are committed to safeguarding the privacy and security of all users. This document transparently details our data handling procedures in strict conformity with Google Play Developer Program Policies, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), and the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA).

Core Guarantee: We do not sell, rent, monetize, or harvest any personal data. The App operates as a direct client tool between your smartphone and your Smart TV.

2. Information We Do NOT Collect

To ensure complete user peace of mind, the App explicitly does NOT collect:

  • Personal Identity Data: No names, email addresses, phone numbers, or social media logins.
  • Location Data: No GPS, coarse location, or cell-tower geolocation coordinates.
  • Media & Files: No access to your private camera, microphone, photo library, or file storage.
  • Viewing Habits: No logs of TV channels watched, media playback history, or streaming activity.

3. Advertising & Third-Party Services

In the standard free version of the App, standard third-party advertising SDKs (such as Google AdMob) may be utilized to support ongoing maintenance and feature development. These services may process non-sensitive device identifiers (such as the Google Advertising ID / GAID) in accordance with Google Play's Families Policy and User Data Policies.

Users can upgrade to the VIP Ad-Free version at any time to permanently disable all advertisements and eliminate third-party ad network communication entirely.

4. Children's Privacy (COPPA & GDPR-K)

Universal TV Remote Control is designed for general audiences and families. We do not knowingly target, solicit, or collect personal data from children under the age of 13 (or under 16 in the European Union). The App does not contain age-inappropriate content or interactive chat features.

5. Data Security & Local Encryption

All local television pairing data (such as local IP address, device model name, or secure authentication tokens required by Samsung Tizen or LG webOS) is stored exclusively on your device's private sandboxed storage (Android SharedPreferences / Encrypted Data Store). This information never leaves your device and is permanently destroyed if you clear application cache or uninstall the App.

6. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may periodically update our Privacy Policy to reflect app enhancements or evolving regulatory guidelines. Any modifications will be posted immediately to this official URL with an updated "Last Modified" timestamp.
